scientific_integrity: The classification is proved algebraically and tested in small finite fields; no independent audit or external mathematical certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Squarefree companion pencils only; repeated roots and singular or nonregular pencils are not treated.
The zeta function recovers irreducible-factor degree multiplicities, not individual irreducible polynomials.
Geometric assertions concern the indicated determinantal rank-one subscheme; no general classification of Lie algebra isomorphism types is claimed.
The examples checked computationally cannot substitute for proofs for all finite fields and dimensions.
Unidentified specialized literature could contain equivalent results.
title: Squarefree Pfaffian Lie pencils: centralizer strata and Frobenius zeta functions
